name: Fastighetsbolaget Emilshus AB (publ)
summary: Headquartered in Vetlanda, Sweden, Fastighetsbolaget Emilshus AB (publ) is a Swedish enterprise that focuses on acquiring, developing, and managing commercial real estate throughout the country. Its diverse portfolio of properties supports a wide range of functions, including industrial activities, storage, specialized professional services, retail and grocery operations, community amenities, and corporate offices. The company began its operations in 2018.
